scope: Fixed paired pipeline on four new aerial stock clips: platform pinnipeds, surf animal, rocky-islet pinnipeds, and crowded-beach control. Not DJI field or annotated-box accuracy validation.
paired_design: Identical DMD animal proposals and identical Gemini image inputs/decisions for both arms. Only context detections differ: DMD baseline versus YOLO-World full-frame context.
gate: Frozen same-check crop+scene agreement OR two consecutive scene yes checks within four seconds, then existing three-second source-scene hold.
limits: All four sources are aerial views newly reviewed in this study; source equipment/altitude and model pretraining overlap are not independently known.
Only one newly reviewed crowded-beach control; screening cannot prove exhaustive animal absence. No verified marine-plus-person/vehicle co-occurrence positive in these clips.
Context shown means gated detector proposals; no exhaustive bounding-box or identity truth and no validation of each displayed box.
Source-time replay excludes model/API scheduling latency. Native-video shot cuts and current animal disappearance timestamps are not annotated.
Animal confirmation is non-human mammal presence, not injury, urgency, danger or rescue need. No automatic incident/dispatch.
No production integration or deployment; training weights and prompts unchanged.
visibility_annotation: No exhaustive frame-level animal visibility or box annotations. Gate-open counts are evidence persistence/proposal diagnostics, never video recall.
entry_exit_scope: Source changes and expiration are checked by replay and policy fixtures. Natural animal disappearance and automatic shot-cut detection are not validated.

source_screening.raft: Clearly visible sea lions on floating platform, birds also present; no people identified.
source_screening.surf: Small nonhuman animal visible in surf at screened middle/later frames; wave occlusion makes continuous visibility uncertain.
source_screening.rocks: Group of pinnipeds visible on offshore rock in native crop; no people identified.
source_screening.crowded_beach: Crowded overhead beach, people and umbrellas; no nonhuman mammal identified in screening; absence not exhaustively annotated.

context_box_diagnostic.scope: Post-hoc diagnostic on two selected aerial failure frames and one previously inspected ground-level seal+person+truck frame. No held-out result or production adoption.

manual_context_error_examples.manual_visual_subject: Surfacing nonhuman animal; no human body in this target crop.
Rock carrying pinnipeds; no vehicle in this target crop.

recommendation: Do not promote context branch as-is. Validate proposed context boxes as well as animal presence, add reliable scene-boundary/negative-evidence handling, and evaluate latency. Marine-human/vehicle aerial co-occurrence retention remains untested.
